podcast.body: Written by Stevie Nicks and featured on the album `Rumours`, this became Fleetwood Mac's first and only number one single. The song's lyrics, such as "Players only love you when they're playing," reflected the band's internal relationship dynamics, notably between Nicks and Lindsey Buckingham. "Stevie Nicks wrote this song which was on rumors and became the first and unbelievably the only number one single that Fleetwood Mac ever had."
